derivedFrom.prompt: Repaint this rough colour-blocking sketch as a finished, beautifully painted illustration for a cheerful children's learning game set under the sea. Keep the same composition and camera: a sunny, shallow tropical lagoon seen from inside the water, bright sunbeams slanting down from the shimmering surface at the top, a soft sandy sea floor along the bottom, lush coral gardens and swaying kelp on the left and right edges, and wide open calm turquoise water in the centre left empty for game text and buttons. Replace the flat shapes with rich detail: branching pink and orange corals, purple sea fans, round brain corals, sea anemones, scattered seashells and pebbles on the sand, a smooth grey rock, tiny bubbles rising, gentle caustic light ripples on the sand. Style: storybook gouache and watercolour painting, soft brush texture, rounded friendly shapes, bright saturated but harmonious palette of turquoise, aqua blue, coral pink, sunny yellow and sand beige, gentle depth haze toward the back. Calm, magical and inviting, never dark or scary. No fish, no animals, no people, no characters, no text, no letters, no logo, no watermark, no border.

derivedFrom.prompt: Use the grey reference only as a blank canvas. Paint one original cute cartoon character for a cheerful children's learning game set under the sea: Vydra Výskalka, a playful young sea otter floating upright, waving one front paw and laughing with joy. Rounded, chubby, friendly shapes; big shiny dark eyes with white highlights; a small pink nose; fluffy chocolate-brown fur with a cream-coloured face, chest and belly; long whiskers; a thick tail. Storybook gouache and watercolour painting with soft shading and a clean, confident dark-brown outline around the whole character, like a premium picture-book sticker. The whole character is centred and fully inside the frame, head to tail occupying about 80 percent of the image height, nothing cropped. Plain flat light grey background. No environment, no water surface, no bubbles, no other animals, no text, no watermark.
